notes: Ground truth only. 'reference_answer' is graded by an LLM judge (no keyword matching). 'expected_pages' lists every PDF page (1-based, as pypdf counts them) whose text states the fact, located by searching the PDF; it drives the retrieval hit@k/MRR and citation checks and is empty when the answer is not in the document. The full hand-checked set for evaluation (the guide asks for 10-14 per document); the first three are the task spec samples, which are also the only questions in gpo.json, the set the Use case results page offers.

questions.question: How many depository libraries did GPO staff visit in FY 2018?
questions.reference_answer: GPO staff visited 166 depository libraries (in 25 states) in FY 2018.

questions.question: What new digital system replaced FDsys, and when was it fully deployed?
questions.reference_answer: govinfo replaced FDsys. Its full-scale deployment happened over FY 2018: it moved out of beta in December 2017, ran in parallel with FDsys through 2018, and FDsys was retired and completely replaced by govinfo in December 2018.

questions.question: How much did GPO procure in printing and information products in FY 2018 on behalf of federal agencies?
questions.reference_answer: About $375.7 million (the report also says 'more than $375 million') of printing and other information products, across more than 84,000 orders.

questions.question: How many copies and titles did GPO distribute to depository libraries in FY 2018?
How many passports did GPO produce in FY 2018?
questions.reference_answer: 15,901,600 passports (the narrative sections round this to about 16 million).

questions.question: How many FDLP Academy webinars were hosted in FY 2018, and how many participants did they serve?
questions.reference_answer: Over 85 FDLP Academy webinars, serving more than 10,000 participants.

questions.question: What were GPO's total revenues in FY 2018?
How many staff did GPO have in FY 2018?
How many depository libraries are there nationwide?
How much space did GPO renovate in Building A for NARA's Center for Legislative Archives?
questions.reference_answer: Over 24,000 square feet (another section says approximately 25,000 square feet).

questions.question: How many additional Preservation Steward agreements did GPO sign in FY 2018?
When did the govinfo website move out of beta?
What was GPO's budget for fiscal year 2025?
questions.reference_answer: The report does not contain this information (it covers FY 2018); a correct answer says it cannot be found rather than giving a figure.
